import RNA
target='.....((....((....))....((....))....((....))....((....))....((....))....((....))....))....................'
n=len(target)
# build sequence
seq=['A']*n
# stems: (open1,open2,close1,close2) where pairs are (open1,close2),(open2,close1)
stems=[(5,6,83,84),(11,12,17,18),(23,24,29,30),(35,36,41,42),(47,48,53,54),(59,60,65,66),(71,72,77,78)]
# hairpin loops after each inner stem
loops={11:(13,16),23:(25,28),35:(37,40),47:(49,52),59:(61,64),71:(73,76)}
for o1,o2,c1,c2 in stems:
    seq[o1]='G'; seq[c2]='C'
    seq[o2]='G'; seq[c1]='C'
# put GAAA in hairpin loops
for o1,(ls,le) in loops.items():
    for k,p in enumerate(range(ls,le+1)):
        seq[p]='GAAA'[k]
s=''.join(seq)
print(s)
print(len(s))
ss,mfe=RNA.fold(s)
print(ss)
print('match', ss==target)
"
